result.instructions: Tools for FreightSimple, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Get quotes for a pallet shipment from Toronto to Chicago next Tuesday."; "What is the status of shipment shp_… and when is it due to be delivered?"; "List the dangerous goods entries for UN 1203 and save a commodity for it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FreightSimple data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freightsimple_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freightsimple_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freightsimple_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freightsimple_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List the carriers available to this company, with their identifiers. GET /v1/carriers/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_distribution_warehouse_brands
tools.title: List distribution warehouse brands
tools.description: List the distribution warehouse brands (for example Amazon sites) FreightSimple recognises, and whether each needs a delivery deadline. GET /v1/distribution-warehouse-brands/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_dangerous_goods
tools.title: List dangerous goods
tools.description: Look up dangerous goods reference data (UN numbers, classes, packing groups). The optional search text filters on UN number, class, proper shipping name or description. GET /v1/dangerous-goods/list.

search.description: Text to match, for example 1203 or gasoline. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: freightsimple_get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment: its status, the quotes (when quoted), the selected quote, documents and tracking history. Give exactly one of shipment_id or tracking_id. Poll this after start_quoting until shipmentStatus is Quoted. GET /v1/shipments/get-shipment.

shipment_id.description: The shipment id returned by start_quoting.

tracking_id.description: The tracking id (the tId in a tracking link).

tools.name: freightsimple_list_saved_commodities
tools.title: List saved commodities
tools.description: List the saved commodities (reusable product definitions) of this company. GET /v1/saved-commodities/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_get_saved_commodity_by_sku
tools.title: Get saved commodity by SKU
tools.description: Get one saved commodity by its SKU identifier. GET /v1/saved-commodities/get-by-sku.

sku_identifier.description: The SKU identifier of the saved commodity.

tools.name: freightsimple_start_quoting
tools.title: Start quoting
tools.description: Create a shipment and start the carrier quoting process (no cost is committed). Returns shipmentId and warnings. Quoting takes about 30 seconds: then poll freightsimple_get_shipment until shipmentStatus is Quoted. A cross-border shipment needs a broker. POST /v1/shipments/start-quoting.

distributionWarehouseBrand.description: Brand id from list_distribution_warehouse_brands, when the site is one.

addressLine2.description: Use an empty string when there is no second line.

notes.description: Use an empty string when there are no notes.

deadline.description: Only for a location that accepts a delivery deadline.

distributionWarehouseBrand.description: Brand id from list_distribution_warehouse_brands, when the site is one.

addressLine2.description: Use an empty string when there is no second line.

notes.description: Use an empty string when there are no notes.

deadline.description: Only for a location that accepts a delivery deadline.

specialServiceAppointmentRequired.description: True when the carrier must book a delivery appointment.

isStackable.description: Can other freight go on top (default false).

emergencyContact.description: Required when any line item is dangerous.

tdgResponsibleName.description: Needed for a pickup or delivery in Canada.

branchId.description: Branch id from the company address book, if used.

metadata.description: Your own notes or JSON, returned unchanged.

tools.name: freightsimple_start_booking
tools.title: Start booking
tools.description: Book a quote from a quoted shipment. This makes a carrier pickup and commits the cost, so confirm must be true. Use the quoteId from get_shipment. Poll get_shipment until shipmentStatus is BookingConfirmed (about 15 seconds). POST /v1/shipments/start-booking.

quoteId.description: The quoteId of the chosen quote (from get_shipment).

bookingContact.description: Who the operations team contacts about pickup and invoices.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the action goes to the carrier now.

tools.name: freightsimple_upload_customs_documents
tools.title: Upload customs documents
tools.description: Upload customs documents (base64 PDFs, for example the commercial invoice) to a cross-border shipment. Each upload goes straight to the carrier, so confirm must be true. Use mode Replace to swap a corrected set. Upload from BookingConfirmed until delivered. POST /v1/shipments/upload-customs-documents.

shipmentId.description: The shipment id returned by start_quoting.

mode.description: Add keeps the existing documents; Replace swaps them.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the action goes to the carrier now.

tools.name: freightsimple_create_saved_commodity
tools.title: Create saved commodity
tools.description: Save a reusable commodity definition for this company. POST /v1/saved-commodities/create.

tools.name: freightsimple_update_saved_commodity
tools.title: Update saved commodity
tools.description: Replace a saved commodity's fields. Send every required field again, not only the changed ones. POST /v1/saved-commodities/update.

savedCommodityId.description: The id of the saved commodity to update.

tools.name: freightsimple_delete_saved_commodity
tools.title: Delete saved commodity
tools.description: Delete a saved commodity by id. This cannot be undone. POST /v1/saved-commodities/delete.

savedCommodityId.description: The id of the saved commodity to delete.
